body: 40f31e3 Case (b): FightSimulation.gd references bare autoload CompetitionData at lines 896, 904, 2491 inside static func bodies; GDScript compiler resolves all identifiers at compile time, autoloads not registered in --script context, script fails to compile silently (has_method lies true, actual calls fail). load()-inside-a-function fix: NO (resource cache holds broken GDScript from class-scope preload, and load() hits same compile error). check_scripts.py blind: YES (passes FightSimulation.gd green with autoload_refs=1 but fails=0). Fix belongs in FightSimulation.gd: lazy-load CompetitionData or accept as parameter at lines 896, 904, 2491. FightNightScreen works because it is a scene script in a live tree with autoloads present. Standing preload rule is NOT complete - updated wording in research doc.
